mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 6.0%, it signals labor market weakness that may trigger economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of triggered instances (UNRATE > 6.0%), or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal weakening consumer demand, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of such instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) during stagflation risk (CPIAUCSL rising) signals supply-side constraints and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where INDPRO declines and CPIAUCSL rises, or the Rank IC for INDPRO in stagflation regimes is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly real GDP growth (GDPC1) over the past quarter is associated with positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns due to stronger economic fundamentals.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances with positive GDPC1 growth, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may prompt monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%), or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) slows (negative change) and unemployment (UNRATE) rises, it signals a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise fails to predict negative returns: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of such instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), higher interest rates compress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the average return in tightening cycles is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
